HypothesisTitle: DDR5 standards establish the sockets; the implementation envelope remains product-specific
HypothesisStatement: JEDEC establishes MTP NVM in the DDR5 PMIC and a 1024-byte rewritable NVM in the DDR5 SPD Hub. Capacity options, cycle count, PVT, atomicity, recovery and the exact embedded-memory implementation remain product-specific.
ExcludedClaim: The NotebookLM synthesis is not the evidence for these sockets. JEDEC does not require one proprietary SPD bitcell, and neither standard turns live temperature telemetry or dynamic voltage compensation into a continuous NVM workload.
ValidationNeeded: Qualify the target macro against capacity, endurance, PVT, write protection, atomic update, recovery and module- or PMIC-specific lifecycle requirements.
